description: This file defines configuration options and validation logic for an Azure Blob Storage lease provider used within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes classes for setting up the BlobServiceClient, configuring it via various methods, and validating the options.

classes.name: AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for Azure Blob Storage lease provider, including client setup and connection configuration.

classes.name: AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the correctness and completeness of AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions instances.

methods.name: ConfigureBlobServiceClient
methods.description: Sets up the BlobServiceClient using various overloads such as connection string, URI, or callback.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks the options for validity, including container name and client creation.
